tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'dus pa'i bdag bskyed bzhugs/

'dus pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ba'i lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dir 'dus pa'i cho ga'i ngag 'don bya tshul 'jug pa bde bar dgod pa la/ gnas yid dang mthun par rdor dril mchod rdzas sogs tshogs par byas te thog mar/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i reg bya rdo rje mas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku stod lha rdzas kyi gos kyis ga shal byas shing sku smad lha rdzas kyi dar gyi sham thabs 'phyar bar gyur/ rdor dril byin brlab bya ba ni/ rdo rje ni thabs dang dril bu ni shes rab ste/ de gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin no/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha e ka twāṃ dhā ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+ṭā hūṃ/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /hūṃ sems can rmongs dang 'grel ba yi/ /rdo rje gsor ba mdzes pa yis/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba ste/ /spro dang bcas pas rdo rje gzung*/ hūṃ huṃ hūṃ ho ho ho/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ne pradzñā pā ra mi ta nā da swa bhā we badz+ra satwa hraṃ da ya san+to ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho ho ho swāhā/ nang mchod byin brlab ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan ta krita hūṃ/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ gi yaṃ sngo skya las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang sngon zla gam hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/

de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ hūṃ gi raṃ dmar po las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du āḥlas byung ba'i thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du āḥ las byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru las āḥs mtshan pa/ de'i dbus su hūṃ las mi'i sha hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar du bruṃ las glang po che'i sha bruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor āṃ las rta'i sha āṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las ba lang gi sha dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ lam khyi'i sha khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ slar yang dbus su hūṃ las dri chu hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ shar du bruṃ las dri chen bruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta āṃ gis mtshan pa/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang sems dkar po dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ bdud rtsi lnga la thun mong du oṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng gi bar snang la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig las skyes pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de la 'od 'phros/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba'i nang du rdo rje nyi gdan dang bcas pa ltung nas dkrugs pas rdo rje dang rdzas rnams ro mnyam du gyur/ dri ma thams cad spyangs/ shel ltar dag par gyur/ pad+ma āḥdang bcas pa zhu bas nyi ma ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor rtogs par byas/ oṃ yig gi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bsnan pas mang bor sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ sngon 'gro'i mchod pa byin brlab ni/ oṃ āḥ bigh+nā na ta kṛta hūṃ/

oṃ shūn+ya tā zhes pa nas/ haṃ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du aṃ pāṃ puṃ la sogs ba so so'i ming yig dang thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ rnam pa mchod rdzas/ byed las dbang po drug gi spyod yul du zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āñtsa ma ṇaṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke /gan+dha/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta ā hūṃ/ de nas sngon 'gro'i gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ gtor mgron spyan drangs nas gsal gdab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis/ phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa bkug ste phyogs mtshams rnams su gnas pa ni/ shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po mig stong ba/ sa srung dkar po la zhon pa/ rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas su sgyu ma rdo rje nag po nam mkha' lding la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang dbyug to/ g.yon gnyis dung dang nor bu kau tu bha thogs pa/ mer rdo rje me dmar po smin ma dang ral pa'i thod dang sma ra 'bar zhing 'khrug pa/ shin tu tsho ba/ ra la zhon pa/ g.yas gnyis skyabs sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon gnyis ril ba dang dbyu gu 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje dus nag po ma he'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ skra gyen du 'bar zhing khros pa/ g.yas dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ lho nub tu rdo rje gtun shing nag po ro la gnas pa/ gcer bu mi rus kyis brgyan cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu rdo rje klu dkar bo gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/

sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rdo rje rlung ljang ku e na ya ser po la gnas pa/ rlung ras 'dzin pa/ /byang du rdo rje 'jigs byed ser po mi la gnas shing sbom pa/ g.yas ne'u le dang*/ g.yon bi dza bu ra 'dzin pa/ de'i g.yas su rdo rje sna ring dkar po glang po che'i gdong ba can byi ba la gnas pa/ g.yas gnyis la phug dang dbyug pa/ g.yon gnyis la du dang phreng ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du rdo rje khro bo dkar po khyu mchog la gnas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang rus pas rgyan dang ldan pa/ g.yas rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang*/ g.yon cang te'u 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan dang nye dbang gi bar du rdo rje 'khyil ba dmar po shing rta la gnas pa/ bzod par dka' ba'i 'od zer can/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rdo rje 'od dkar po 'khor lo la gnas pa/ g.yas su mu da dang g.yon bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ mi smra rdo rje ser po ngang pa la gnas pa/ g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis bgrang phreng dang dbyig pa 'dzin pa/ chu lha dang bden bral gnyis kyi bar du thag bzang ris nag po shing rta gnas pa/ ral gri 'dzin pa/ sa'i lha mo ser mo pad+ma la gnas pa/ pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dbang po la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug pa las 'dus pa'i lha shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs pa'i mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes ba'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can rnams su gyur/ oṃ ā hrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ mar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ ā ñtsa ma ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhriḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ pro kā chaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes chu bzhi phul nas/ gtor ma 'dul zhing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ āḥ dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyogs bcu yi/ /'jigs rten khams rnams nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/

/rgya mtsho sprin gyi bkod pa rab 'byams kyi/ /shin tu phra ba'i rdul skyes dkyil 'khor ni/ /phan tshun gcig gi nang du gcig son pa/ /snyoms par 'jug pa kun tu gnas pa yi/ /chos kyi dbyings su yang dag par 'du zhing*/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi yongs su mthar thug pa'i/ /dus gsum skyes pa kun dang phyaugs bcu yi/ /'jig rten khams rnams mtha' yas sprin bkod pa/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams mnyam dang 'jig rten skyong*/ /kun dang sems can kun kyang 'di lta ste/ /rdo rje mtshon cha sgyu ma rdo rje dang*/ /rdo rje me dang rdo rje dus dang ni/ rdo rje gtun shing rdo rje klu dag dang*/ rdo rje lung dang rdo rje 'jigs byed dang*/ /rdo rje sna ring rdo rje khro bo dang*/ rdo rje 'khyil ba rdo rje 'od dang ni/ /mi smra rdo rje dang ni thag bzang ris/ /sa yi lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /me tog dag dang bdug pa mar me dang*/ /dri dang lha bshos la sogs yang dag ldan/ /nye bar spyod pa dang ni gtor ma 'di/ /so sor bzhes shing nye bar longs spyad nas/ /bdag gi dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa rnams/ /'phrog par byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren kun/ /sdang dang rab tu sdang ba thams cad dang*/ /mi dang mi ma yin rnams rmongs par mdzod/ /rengs dang bcing dang rnam par 'jig par mdzod/ /bdag la dbyig gser nor 'bru lang tsho tshe/ /nad med pa dang bde ba dam pa dang*/ /bde ba chen po rab tu 'phel ba rnams/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i mthar thug bar/ /gnang bar mdzad cing rtag tu staungs grogs dang*/ zhi ba dang ni srung bar mdzad du gsol/ hūṃ swāhā/ de nas zhal bsil mchod yon nyer spyod nang mchod bzod gsol sogs ni rim pa bzhin/ oṃ āḥhrāṃḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ añtsa ma ṇaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ aḥhīḥpra wa ra sad ka raṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swahā/

oṃ badz+ra taṃ bu la ye swāhā/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ shap+ta pra tāṃ ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa/ sogs yig brgya tshar gcig brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*/ gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ badz+ra muḥphyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ /zhes brjod de se gol gtog /bdag bskyed mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhawa at+ma ko nya haṃ/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ces pa nas/ rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ pāṃ puṃ la sogs pa/ zhes pa nas/ rol mo la sogs pa rnams rang bzhin bde stong*/ zhes pa nas/ bskyed par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ pād+yaṃ/ pushape/ dhū pe/ ālo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta gadhe/ ra sa/ spar sha āḥhūṃ/ zhes dang*/ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa lta bu'i skabs ma yin na ma gtog /'dir maṇ+ḍal 'bul dgos pa'i nges pa mi 'dug kyang*/ 'dod na gzhan du gsal ba ltar/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ sems can thams cad la byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas/ rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa/ /blo yis bslangs nas bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ i daṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍal kaṃ ni rā ta yā mi/ zhes sbyar ba'i rgyas pa'am tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pa tsam gyis 'bul lo/ /skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ yid kyi rol ba dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/

/snying rje dam pa mtha' yas pa yi thabs/ /rang gi yid la gnas par gyur pa ni/ /bde gshegs rnams la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /rtog pa ma lus pa las nges grol zhing*/ /sems dpa' dam pa rnams kyi phun tshogs gzhi/ /dngos po thams cad ro gcig ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /'ching ba rnams las yang dag grol gyur cing*/ /snying rje mchog gis bskrun pa'i dpal dang ldan/ /rab tu dga' sogs sa la rab bzhugs pa/ /brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /bsam dang rnam par smin pa dag gyur pas/ /sgrib pa kun gyi bag chags yang dag 'byin/ /lhag par mos pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor baṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ yab rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ yig dkar po/ /de las 'od 'phros/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ /oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ shap+ta pra tī ts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin gshaigs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang*/ /mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas thugs ka'i hūṃ la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twā sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bhā ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bhā wa/ a nu rak+to me bhā wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa ma/ tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūṃ phaṭa/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yi/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dang dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag go /zhes gsungs nas rang la thim pas rang gi sgo gsum dang rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed par gyur/ de nas tshogs zhing spyan drangs te phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa dang sdig bshags sems bskyed ni/ rang mi bskyod rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bri ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mi skyod pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/

/'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ p+ta d+ya/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar sha/ zhes sbyar/ gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba 'du shes 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes dang skye mched drug dang dbang po drug /sa chu me dang rlung dang nam mkha' thams cad ni/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gti mug nyes pa 'dod chags rdo rje chos bcas gang*/ /rig pa'i sbyor ba las byung rtag tu rab 'brel bar/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dga' bas myos pa'i dngos gyur pa/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdud dang dag dang rnam pa de bzhin mi 'gyur dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rang bzhin sems su rjes thogs chos/ /rmongs dang zhe sdang 'dod chags sgrib ba rdo rje ste/ /byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ /ma lus kun rtog gis bsags rnyog pa rnams/ /thugs rje che ldan spyan sngar de dag ni/ /cho ga bzhin du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /'phags pa gzhan gyis dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yi rang zhing*/ byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /yid kyi rol ba dri med zla 'dras bsgrubs/ /zhes pa nas/ sems ni byang chub dam par bskyed par bgyi/ /bde gshegs sras bcas rnams kyi lam gcig pu/ /sbyin sogs rnam bcu dkar po'i yon tan tshul/ rdzogs sangs rgyas bdag ma lus ngo bo'i blos/ yang dag nyid du de ni gnas par bgyi/ /de nas rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/

/byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bdag gis bzung*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas bdag gis bzung*/ /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po yi/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin ni dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du so sor bzung*/ / mchod pa'i las ni ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung*/ /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*/ /sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod*/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor phur gdab dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho nya haṃ/ chos rnams kyi ngo bo rgyu 'bras gsum rang gi mtshan nyid gyis grub pas stongs pa'i stong ba nyid du gyur/ /stong ba'i ngang las baṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar aḥlas byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ ser po las byung ba'i 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu ba g.yas skor du mgyogs par 'khor ba/

rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprin gyi 'phreng ba phyog bcur 'phro ba/ lte ba'i nang gi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad kyi rtse mo dang lte ba'i nang gi steng 'og gi rtsibs la cung zad ma reg par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan re re/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par mdzes pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ rang gi thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte ba'i nang du ting nge sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon po/ rang gi spyi bor sku rdo rje ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥdamar po/ /thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po/ /yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i thugs ka'i ting nge sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa la khro bo bcus bskor ba spyan drangs/ /zhal nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum kyi pad+mar zhu ba'i thig le bcu gcig hūṃ ring bo bcu gcig tu gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa dang khro bo bcur gyur pa'i mi bskyod pa nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/

g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dh+rika thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcur 'phraus/ chos 'khor bskor ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par du yang sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul ba rnams gcig tu 'dus/ mi bskyod pa ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres nas rang la rjes su zhugs pas sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan du gyur pa'i steng du rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag khro ba dang 'dod chags chen po 'dres pa'i nyams can/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ rtsa zhal nag bo drag po/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhig /g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyad pa/ yum rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mor gyur pa ni/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba phyed bcings su byas pa/ shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa zur gyi blta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ lang tsho dar la bab cing 'dod yon lnga'i dga' bas rol ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ rin po che'i snyan rgyan dang*/ snyan gong ut+pala'i gdengs ka dang dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i mgul rgyan dang*/ mu tig gi se mo do dang*/ rin po che'i do shal dang*/ phyag gdub dang*/ zhabs gdub dang*/rin po che'i 'og bag ste rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyi brgyan pa/ sku stod lha rdzas kyi gos gyis ga shal byas shing*/

sku smad lha rdzas kyi dar gyi sham thabs 'phyar ba/ 'od dmar po 'bar zhing 'khrug pa'i dbus na snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can du gyur/ /gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can/ nag dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs gar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs/ ya mān+ta kṛta thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ /shar gyi rtsibs kyi rtse mo'i steng gi rang gi gdan la g.yon brkyang gis 'khod/ shes rab mthar byed dkar bo rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i= g.yas rdo rje rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra lta 'dzin pa/ rang gi= /pradzñā n+ta kṛta= lho'i= rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ /dmar nag dkar ba'i= g.yas pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas bkur brten cing dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rang gi= pad+ma n+ta ta kṛta= nub kyi= bgeg mthar byed nag po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rang gi= bigh+nan ta kṛta= byang gi= /mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rang gi= a tsa la= shar lho'i= 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i= dang po gnyis kyis hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya 'ching zhing lhag ma g.yas rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ rang gi= ṭak+ki rā dza= lho nub kyi= dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/

sngo dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/ /g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing pad+ma dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rang gi= nī la daṇ+ḍa= nub byang gi= stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing rtse gsum dgra sta 'dzin pa/ rang gi= ma hā pā la= byang shar gyi= /gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i= dang po gnyis kyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya 'ching zhing*/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs mdzub ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang gi= uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra wa rti= steng gi rtsibs kyi nang gi= gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi /g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ rang gi thugs kar drangs sum+bha rā da thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ 'og gi rtsibs kyi nang gi rang gi gdan la g.yon brkyang gis 'khod/ khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes shing smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser rab tu 'bar ba/ zhal re re yang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs drag po sgrog cing bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ gsus khyim che zhing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings shing 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khro bos dpung pa la brgyan cing pad+ma dkar pos mgul rgyan byas pa/ dung skyong ser pos lag gdub byas shing stobs rgyu ljang gus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/

nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ska rags byas shing pad+ma chen po dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ bdag nyid kyi 'og gi gnod mdzes la bltas pas des sprul ba'i gnod mdzes gnyis pa de 'og nas mdun du 'dug ste bdag gis ci zhig bgyi zhes bka' nod pa la/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa huṃ/ gṛh+ṇā pā ya gṛh+ṇā pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wan bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces gnod mdzes la bos nas bgegs rnams zungs la khug cig ces bka' bsgos pas gnod mdzes kyi phyag g.yas kyi dang po'i rdo rje de rdo rje lcags kyur gyur nas bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu'i snying ga nas lcags kyus bzung*/ mgrin pa nas zhags pas bcings te bkug nas khro bo bcu la gtad pas phyi rol tu huṃ ring bo las grub pa'i khron pa 'brub khung gi rnam pa can rnams su bcug par gyur/ byang gi bdud rtsi 'khyil bas sprul pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba gnyis pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ stod khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sngon po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad mdud rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can gyi phur bu me dpung rab tu 'bar ba bcur gyur te phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa'i mgo bor zug par gyur/ o gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣ+ti phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dhā ra adzñā pa ya ti sarba bighāṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag mtshan rdo rje lcags kyu de rdo rje tho ba me 'bar bar gyur te/

shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhi dang*/ me nas brtsams te mtshams bzhi dang*/ steng 'og gi phur bu rnams kyis spyi bo nas brdungs pas bgeg rnams kyi spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phur bu btab pas lus ngag yid gsum g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ sprul ba'i gnod mdzes 'og gi gnod mdzes la thim/ slar yang khro bau dang phur bu las rdo rje'i me 'od rab tu 'bar ba phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor gyi bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshig pas phan tshun du bros par gyur/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥkhro bo rnams kyi phyi rol tu lcags kyi rdo rje'i ra ba/ ṭak+ki huṃ dzaḥ de'i phyi rol tu chu'i ra ba/ ṭak+ki huṃ dzaḥde'i phyi rol tu me'i ra ba/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ de'i phyi rol tu rlung gi ra ba/ hūṃ las lcags kyi ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i gur mchod rten lta bu/ gur gyi 'og ra ba'i steng du rdo rje'i bla re 'og gzhi hūṃ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyi'i phyogs mtshams thams cad du mda'i dra ba ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur/ lha rnams kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum ngag tu yang bzla/ de nas ye shes kyis bsgoms te lhag mos kyi rten brten pa bskyed pa ni/ dngos po med pas bsgom pa med/ /bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min/ /de ltar dngos po dngos med pas/ sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o/ /snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad don dam par ngo bo nyid med par/ sgom pa dang bsgom par bya ba dang sgom pa po gsum mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re me ri dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su chos 'byung dkar po zur gsum pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing rtse mo phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ gi yaṃ sngo skya las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/

hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ raṃ huṃ gi raṃ dmar po las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa/ hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du huṃ baṃ hūṃ gi baṃ dkar po las byung ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ laṃ hūṃ gi laṃ ser po las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor ser bo gru bzhi pa/ hūṃ gnyis las byung ba'i rdo rje gnyis kyis phyogs gnyis brgyan pa spyan sogs lha mo bzhi'i ngo bo gyur/ dkyil 'khor bzhi pau gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa'i lte ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ dkar po sangs rgyas kyi sprin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i rtsigs pas bskor ba'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu gzhi dmar po la rin po che zur gsum pa dang gru bzhi pa la sogs pas smras pa/ de'i steng na gnas pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas mu tig gi do shal dang do shal phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'-i phyi ngos su bya 'dab las 'phyang ba'i rin po che'i shar bu/ de'i steng na pad+ma 'dab ma phyed pa'i dbyibs can gyi mda' yab la gnas pa'i gser gyi bum pa nas thon pa'i rgyal mtshan dang ba dan brgyad brgyad kyis mdzes par byed pa/ phyi'i steng gi zur bzhi la gdugs bzhis brgyan pa/ rtsigs pa'i 'gram nas 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar pos bskor ba la bzhugs stabs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa byed bzhin pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi phyi'i mtshams dang rtsigs pa'i phyi nang gi zur bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rin po che dmar po'i steng du rdo rjes brgyan pa/

sgo bzhi so so'i mdun du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i steng du bum pa la gnas pa'i ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs gser/ shar bu/ rin po che/ rta rmig /mun snam/ wa raṇ+ḍa/ mun pa/ shar bu/ rin po che/ rmig pa/ mda' yab ste rnam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo bcas pa/ rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du bum pa bzang po la skyes pa'i dpag bsam gyi shing la rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bar bar du grub pa thob pa dang*/ sprin gyi gseb nas byung ba'i lha me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba rnams kyis kun nas mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang dkyil 'khor gyi phyed kyi chad kyi phyi ngos su 'od zer rnam pa lnga'i 'phreng bas bskor ba'i nang du rdo rje rtse gsum pas zlum por bskor ba la brten pa'i shar du 'khor lo/ /lhor rin po che/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du ral gris mtshan pa'i ka ba gnyis gnyis kyi btegs pa'i rdo rje gdung gis mdzes par phub pa'i rtse mo rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i grwa'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su bdud rtsis pa gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis gnyis te bum pa brgyad kyi mdzes par byed pa/ lha dang mi las yon tan kyang bar du 'phags pa'i khang bzang dam pa phyi bltas nang gsal ba/ nang bltas phyi gsal ba'i nang gi steng dang 'og gi sa gzhi thams cad shar dkar lho ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus sngo bar gyur pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan sum bcu rtsa gcig /gtso bo dang khro bo bcu la nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam snang la sogs pa'i shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba'i gdan/ mā ma kī la rdo rje'i gdan/ de ma gtogs pa'i lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che'i gdan/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po'i gdan/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du skad cig gis lhag par mos pa tsam gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis dus gcig tu yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni/

dbus kyi gdan la rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje/ zhes pa nas/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang bo sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yum reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ dbu skra ral ba phyed bcings su byas pa/ shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zhes pa nas/ sham thabs 'phyar ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na yab sems dpa'i skyil mo zung gis bzhugs par gyur/ /shar du rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas 'khor rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i= ser nag dkar ba'i= g.yas nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i= dmar nag dkar ba'i= g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dmar po'i rtsa ba dkur brten nas 'dzin cing*/ g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar pad+ma kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang ku mi bskyod pa'i= ljang nag dkar ba'i= g.yas ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi= dkar nag dmar ba'i= g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= sngo dkar dmar pa'i= /g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi= dmar nag dkar ba'i= g.yon gyi dang pos dril bu dang gcas pa'i ut+pal dmar po sdong bu dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba dkur rten nas 'dzin cing*/

g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar ut+pal kha 'byed par mdzad pa/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang ku don grub kyi dbu= ljang nag dkar ba'i= g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi= dkar nag dmar ba'i= rtsa phyag gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin cing lhag ma g.yas rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi= ser nag dkar ba'i= rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi wang sngon po bsgreng zhing*/ lhag ma g.yas 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'og dpag med kyi= /dmar nag dkar ba'i= rtsa phyag gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin cing*/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo/ /g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ljang ku don grub kyi= ljang nag dkar ba'i= rtsa phyag gnyis kyis ro'i snod 'dzin cing*/ lhag ma g.yas 'khor lo rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ut+pal/ g.yon rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ rin po che'i snyan rgyan dang*/ zhes sogs bsrung 'khor gyi gtso bo'i yul gyi skabs bzhin/ sku smad lha rdzas kyi dar gyi sham thabs can/ shin tu sgeg cing*/ zhes pa nas/ dga' bas rol ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rang rang gi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ shar sgo'i g.yas g.yon gyi gdan la rim pa bzhin du byams pa dang sa snying dkar po rnam snang gi= dkar nag dmar ba'i= g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/

byams pa'i phyag g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ lho sgo'i= phyag rdor dang nam snying ser po rin 'byung gi= ser nag dkar ba'i= phyag mtshan rin 'byung lta bu/ nub sgo'i= /'jig rten dbang phyug dang 'jam dpal dmar po 'od dpag med kyi= dmar nag dkar pa'i= /phyag mtshan 'od dpag med lta bu/ byang sgo'i= sgrib sel dang kun bzang ljang gu don grub kyi= ljang nag dkar ba'i= phyag mtshan don grub lta bu/ rnam snang nas kun bzang gi bar gyi lha lhag ma thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba/ zhes pa nas/ sku smad lha rdzas gyi dar gyi sham thabs can/ mtshan bzang po= dpe byad bzang po= brgyan pa/ zhi ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rang rang gi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ shar sgor gshin rje gshed nag po rnam nang gi= /nag dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas dbyug pa 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po rin 'byung gi= nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po= byang sgor bgegs mthar bya nag po= /shar lhor mi g.yo ba nag po= /lho nub tu 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po= nub byang du dbyug sngon can sngon po= byang shar du stobs po che sngon po= steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po= /'og tu gnod mdzes rgyan po sngon po= khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang*/ zhes pa nas/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ /ces pa'i bar rnams bsrung 'khor gyi skabs ltar ro/ /lhag mos kyi lha'i mdzad pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad bkug ste dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i 'jug pas zhugs pa la yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis dbang bskur bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bde ba dang yid bde ba thob ste rdo rje sems dpa' gyur nas rang rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs par gyur/

lhag mos kyi lha lus la bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rnam snang nas gnod mdzes kyi bar gyi lha rnams spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su 'khod nas gzugs kyi phung po la sogs pa dang ngo bo dbyer med du gyur pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla'i rtsa bar don yod grub pa/ lte bar spyan ma/ snyig gar ma ma kī/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ /spyi gtsug tu sgrol ma/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug snying gar 'jam dpal/ gsang gnas su sgrib pa rnam sel/ tshig rnams la kun tu bzang po/ spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna ba'i sgor sgra rdo rje ma/ sna'i sgor dri rdo rje ma/ kha'i sgor ro rdo rje ma/ rdo rje'i sgor reg bya rdo rje ma/ lag pa g.yas la gshin rje gshed/ lag pa g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung ba g.yas pa'i rtsa bar mi g.yo ba/ dpung ba g.yon pa'i rtsa bar 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas la dbyug sngon can/ pus mo g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ lhag mos 'od gsal du bsdus nas 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer bsgom pa ni/ bdag nyid kyi lus kyi lha rnam snang*/ spyan ma/ sa'i snying po/ gzugs rdo rje ma/ byams pa/ gshin rje gshed/ mi g.yo ba rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas rin 'byung*/ mā ma kī/ phyag rdor/ sgra rdo rje ma/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas 'od dpag med/ gos dkar mo/ nam mkha'i snying po/ dri rdo rjai ma/ rta mgrin/

dbyug sngon can rnams rim gyi 'od gsal du thim/ de nas don grub/ sgrol ma/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ro rdo rje ma/ sgrib sel/ reg bya rdo rje ma/ kun bzang*/ bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim/ de nas gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ gnod mdzes rgyal po/ 'jam dpal rnams rim gyis 'od gsal du thim zhing*/ gtso bo yang rim gyis 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ /oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ bar do longs sku'i lam khyer bsgom pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar oṃ āḥhūṃ gi yi ge gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa cig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad bsdus te zla ba la thim/ oṃ dhar+m+mā dhā tu swa bhā wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ snod bcud kyi chos thams cad gyi rtsa ba rlung sems tsam zla bar snang ba de nga'o/ /zla ba'i steng du chu las chu bur rdol ba'i tshul du zla ba las byung ba'i oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūṃ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu nas rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la oṃ āḥhūṃ gis mtshan pa/ badz+ra at+ma ko3 haṃ/ rdo rje yi ge dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dang po'i mgon po sku mdog dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rjai 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ de nas skye ba sprul sku'i lam khyer bsgom pa ni/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum sems can 'dul ba'i phyir du snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems las grub pa'i mi bskyod pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa byas/ des sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlabs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang yid bde ba thob par gyur/ mi bskyod pa thams cad kyang gzhal yas khang gi nang du gcig tu 'dres pa la rang nyid rjes su zhugs pas rang nyid sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i= g.yas rdo rje= ral gri 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ de nas rten gyi lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi mdun rgyab dang g.yas g.yon bzhi ni dkyil 'khor gyi zur bzhi/ kha sna bshang gci'i lam gyi bug pa bzhi ni sgo bzhi'i rnam rtog gi bzhon pa ye shes lnga dag pa'i rlung kha dog lnga pa ni rtsig pa rim pa lnga/ lce'i rnam par shes pa ni rin po che'i pha gu/ rgyu ma dra ba/ rgyus pa dra phyed/ byang sems dkar po'i cha zla ba phyed pa/ mig gi rnam shes ni me long*/ sna'i rnam shes ni me tog gi 'phreng ba/ lce'i dbang po ni dril bu/ lus kyi dbang po'i tshogs rnga yab tu gyur pa rnams ni dra ba dang dra phyed kyi rgyan no/ /rna ba dang lus kyi rnam shes ni mda' yab la gnas pa'i ba dan dang dar 'phan/ rje ngar brla dpung lag ngar gyi rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ lto ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi bum pa/ rna ba'i dbang po ni mtshams rnams kyi zla phyed rdo rje/ phung po lnga rnam par dag pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi kha dog lnga/ gsang gnas lte ba snying ga gdong gi sna rtse bzhi ni rta babs bzhi/ mig gi dbang po ni de'i steng gi 'khor lo/ /yid kyi rnam shes ni ri dwags/ sna'i dbang po ni rta babs kyi ba dan/ yid kyi dbang po ni dbus kyi pad+ma ste/ de ltar lus kyi cha thams cad gzhal yas khang gi cha so sor gyur/

de nas brtan pa'i lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ rang gi spyi gtsug nas skra mtshams kyi bar du gzugs kyi phung po'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dkar nag dmar ba'i= g.yas 'khor lo rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams nas mgrin pa'i bar du 'du shes kyi phung po āḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i= dmar nag dkar pa'i= mgrin pa nas nu ma gnyis kyi dbus kyi snying ga'i bar du rnam shes kyi phung po'i ngo bo hūṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po mi bskyod pa'i/ zhes sogs tshig lhag ma sbyor tshul 'og ma thams cad la gong gis rigs bsgre/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar du tshor ba'i phung po'i ngo bo swā ser po= rin 'byung ser po mi bsgyod pa'i= /lte ba nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar du 'du byed kyi phung po'i ngo bo hā ljang gu= don grub ljang gu mi bskyod pa'i= lte bar lus kyi sa'i khams thams cad kyi ngo bo laṃ yongs su gyur pa las spyan ma dkar mo rnam snang gi= snying gar lus kyi chu'i khams sa thams cad kyi ngo bo māṃ= mā ma kī sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= mgrin par lus kyi ma'i khams thams cad kyi ngo bo baṃ= gos dkar mo dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi= spyi gtsug tu lus kyi rlung gi khams thams cad kyi ngo bo tāṃ= sgrol ma ljang ku don grub kyi= mig tu mig dbang gi ngo bo th+l+hiṃ= sa snying dkar pau rnam snang gi= mig gi sgor lus kyi gzugs kyi rang bzhin dzaḥ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo rnam snang gi= ral gri 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i phyag dang po gnyis kyi phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ rna bar rna ba'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ= phyag rdor ser po rin 'byung gi= rna ba'i sgor lus kyi sgra'i rang bzhin hūṃ=

sgra rdo rje ma ser mo rin 'byung gi= ral gri 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i= snar sna'i dbang bo ngo bo oṃ= nam snying ser po rin 'byung gi= sna'i sgor lus kyi dri'i rang bzhin paṃ= dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med kyi= 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i= lcer lce'i dbang po'i ngo bo oṃ/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po 'od dpag med kyi= kha'i sgor lus kyi ro'i rang bzhin hoḥ= /ro rdo rje ma ljang ku don grub kyi= 'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i= snying gar yid dbang gi ngo bo hūṃ= 'jam dpal dmar po 'od dpag med kyi= rdo rjer lus dbang gi ngo bo oṃ= sgrib sel ljang ku don grub kyi= rdo rjer sgor lus kyi reg bya'i rang bzhin khaṃ= reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= /'dzin pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i= tshigs rnams la tshigs rnams kyi ngo bo saṃ= kun bzang ljang gu don grub kyi= spyi gtsug tu lus kyi rtsa dang rgyus pa'i ngo bo me= byams pa dkar po rnam snang gi= phyag drug gi g.yas klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa rdo rje pad+ma dkar po/ /g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rnam snang nas byams pa'i bar gyi lha thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du gyur/ lag pa g.yas la de'i ngo bo hūṃ= gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi= lag pa g.yon la de'i hūṃ= gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po rin 'byung gi= kha la= hūṃ= rta mgrin dmar po 'od dpag med kyi= rdo rje la= hūṃ= bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sngon po don grub kyi= dpung pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar= hūṃ= mi g.yo ba nag po rnam snang gi= dpung pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar= hūṃ= 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngon po rin byung gi= pus mo g.yas la= hūṃ= dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi= pus mo g.yon la= hūṃ= stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi=

spyi gtsug tu= hūṃ= gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i= rkang thil gnyis su de'i ngo bo huṃ yongs su gyur pa las gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po mi bskyod pa'i= phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa bzung nas sdigs mdzub mdzad cing pad+ma ral gri 'dzin pa/ khro bo bcu po thams cad kyang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brjes pa la sogs pa khro bo'i nyams thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de nas sgo gsum so so'i byin brlabs la sku byin brlab ni/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba las spyan ma'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros pas skad cig gis sku rdo rje rnam snang gi lha'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad spyan ma dang sbyor ba'i mdun na rang nyid gnas par gyur/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas sku 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje skus ni mdzad du gsol/ /zhes rnam snang gtso 'khor la gsol ba btab pas spros pa'i spyan ma dang spyan drangs pa'i rnam snang gi sgo nas lha'i tshogs gnyis po thams cad phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba myong*/ 'od zer dkar bo'i ngo bor zhugs ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis bdag nyid kyi rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas zhugs te ye shes kyi sa thob pas lus thams cad bkang ste tshim nas sku'i dbang phyug thob par gyur/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang yin/ phung po lnga yis rab bkang

ba/ /sangs rgyas sku yi ngo bo yis/ /bdag kyang de dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ka3 haṃ/ gsung byin brlabs ni/ rang gi lce'i dbus su āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥdamar po 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba las gos dkar mo'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spros pas skad cig gis gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi lha'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba sbyan drangs pa'i dbus nas bzhugs pa'i gtso bo 'od dpag med gos dkar mo dang sbyor ba'i mdun na rang nyid gnas par gyur/ /chos kyi gsung lam dpal ldan pa/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs ba'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje gsung gis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes 'od dpag med gtso 'khor la gsol ba btab pas spros pa'i gos dkar mo dang spyan drangs pa'i 'od dpag med kyi lha'i tshogs gnyis po thams cad phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba myong*/ /'od zer dmar po'i ngo bor zhu ba ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis bdag nyid kyi lce la zhugs te ye shes kyi sa thob pas lus thams cad bkang ste tshim nas gsung gi dbang phyug thob par gyur/ rdo rje chos kyi gsung gang yin/ /nges pa'i tshig ni phun sum tshogs/ /bdag gi tshig kyang de 'dra zhing*/ /chos 'dzin pa dang 'dra bar shog /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta wā ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ thugs byin brlab ni/ rang gi snying ga'i dbus su hūṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar hūṃ sngon po 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phro ba las mā ma ki'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spos pas skad cig gis thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i lha'i tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gtso bo mi bskyod pa mā ma kī dang sbyor ba'i mdun na rang nyid gnas par gyur/

/dpal ldan rdo rje thugs 'chang ba/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyi brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /rdo rje mi phyed gsum bsgoms pas/ /deng bdag byin gyis brlabs nas su/ /rdo rje thugs kyis mdzad du gsol/ /zhes mi bskyod pa gtso 'khor la gsol ba btab pas spros pa'i mā ma kī dang spyan drangs pa'i mi bskyod pa'i lha'i tshogs gnyis po thams cad phan tshun rjes su chags pa sngon du 'gro bas snyoms par zhugs/ mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba myong*/ 'od zer nag po'i ngo bor zhu ba ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis bdag nyid kyi snying gar zhugs te ye shes kyi sa thob pas lus thams cad bkang ste tshim nas thugs kyi dbang phyug thob par gyur/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs gang yin/ gsang ba'i dbang bo blo ldan pa/ bdag kyang de dang 'drar 'gyur zhing*/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang mtshungs 'gyur shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ sgo gsum thun mong ba'i byin brlab ni/ rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen por gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ de nas sems dpa' gzhan gnyis dang rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ni/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' rdo rje 'chang sngon por gsal ba'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang gi shes rab ma la 'khyud pa/ kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas lus rgyas par byed pa/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba'i lte ba'i nang du ting nge sems dpa' hūṃ yig sngon po rtag tu 'chang ba mar me chen po lta bu mi shes pa'i mun pa 'joms pa'i don du snang ba phung po chen po lta bur gyur/

dam tshig sems dpa'i ral pa'i cod pan la rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang lhan cig kha sbyor gyi sbyor bas byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi 'dzag pa'i rgyud gyi lus thams cad tshim par byed par gyur/ de nas rig ma 'du bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas rang rigs kyi rig ma byung*/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rig ma stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ las rdo rje khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral ba phyed bcings su byas pa/ shin tu sgeg cing = dga' bas rol ba/ de'i spyi gtsug nas skra mtshams kyi bar du oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i= ral gri 'dzin pa/ skra mtshams nas mgrin pa'i bar du āḥdamar po yongs su gyur pa las 'od dpag med dmar po mi bskyod pa'i= /ral gri 'dzin pa/ mgrin pa nas nu ma gnyis kyi dbus kyi snying ga'i bar du hūṃ sngon po yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po mi bskyod pa'i= ral gri 'dzin pa/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar du swa ser po yongs su gyur pa las rin 'byung ser po mi bskyod pa'i= ral gri 'dzin pa/ lte ba nas brla'i rtsa ba'i bar du hā ljang gu yongs su gyur pa las don grub ljang ku mi bskyod pa'i= nor bu 'dzin pa/ lte bar laṃ/ las spyan ma/ snying gar māṃ las mā ma ki/ mgrin par baṃ las dkar mo/ spyi gtsug tu tāṃ las sgrol ma/ mig tu dzaḥlas gzugs rdo rje ma la sa snying gis 'khyud pa/ rna bar hūṃ las sgra rdo rje ma la phyag rdor gyis 'khyud pa/ snar baṃ las dri rdo rje ma la nam snying gis 'khyud pa/ lcer ho las ro rdo rje ma la 'jig rten dbang phyug gis 'khyud pa/

bha gar khaṃ las reg bya rdo rje ma la sgrib sel gyis 'khyud pa/ lag pa g.yas la hūṃ las ro langs ma/ lag pa g.yon la hūṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ kha la hūṃ las khro gnyer can ma/ bha gar hūṃ las ral gcig ma/ dpung ba g.yas pa'i rtsa bar hūṃ las de bzhin gshegs pa'i yum rdo rje ma/ dpung ba g.yon pa'i rtsa bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rin chen ma/ pus mo g.yas la hūṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma/ pus mo g.yon la hūṃ las sna tshogs las ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūṃ las nam mkha'i rdo rje ma/ rkang mthil gnyis su hūṃ las sa 'dzin lha mo rnams su gyur/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa rwa dbus ma'i nor bu la oṃ yig gi mtshan zhing bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ /rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang bar gyur/ rang nyid rin 'byung du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang du gyur/ hūṃ snyoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas par byas pas mchog tu dga' ba'i bde ba thob/ rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi rten brten pa bskyed de mdzad pa mdzad nas dkyil 'khor la dgod pa ni/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad tshim nas zhu ba'i thig le yum gyi pad+mar phab pa de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur/ thig le cha gcig bh+ruṃ dang*/ de yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gdan dang bcas par gyur/ thig le cha gcig gdan de rnams kyi steng du cha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur/

de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥswā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥmāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhoḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥmai hūṃ/ oṃ āḥth+l+hīṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ bcu rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ /rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rdo rje/ ut+pal/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ me long dmar po/ bi wang sngon po/ dri'i dung chos/ ro'i snod/ klu shing gi me tog sdong bu dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa/ 'khor lo/ rin po che gnyis/ pad+ma gnyis/ ral gri gnyis/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po/ rdo rje dang rdo rje/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rim gyis lha sum cu rtsa gnyis su gyur pa ni/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du rang nyid mi bskyod pa zhi ba mthing nag mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ rang nyid reg bya rdo rje ma sngon mo mi bskyod pa'i= g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas par= 'dod yon= yab yum gnyis ka'i phyag dang po gnyis kyis phan tshun du 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba= sham thabs 'phyar ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus na yab sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/

shar du rang nyid rnam snang dkar po mi bskyod pa'i= lhor rang nyid rin 'byung = nub tu rang nyid 'od dpag med= byang du rang nyid don grub= shar lhor rang nyid spyan ma= lho nub tu rang nyid mā ma kī= nub byang du rang nyid gos dkar mo= byang shar du rang nyid sgrol ma= rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor rang nyid gzugs rdo rje ma= lho nub tu rang nyid sgra rdo rje ma= nub byang du rang nyid dri rdo rje ma= byang shar du rang nyid ro rdo rje ma= lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang dbu skra ral pa phyed bcings su byas pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba= sham thabs can/ shin tu sgeg cing bzhin 'dzum bag dang ldan pa= 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rang rang gi gdan la rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rang nyid shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa dang*/ g.yon du sa snying dkar po= rang nyid lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag rdor dang*/ g.yon du nam snying = rang nyid nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal= /rang nyid byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib sel dang*/ g.yon du kun bzang = rnam snang nas kun bzang gi bar gyi lha lhag ma thams cad kyang rin po che'i dbu rgyan gsol ba= sham thabs ca= mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus nabargyan pa/ zhi ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rang rang gi gdan la rdo rje'-i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ shar sgor rang nyid gshin rje gshed nag po rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can/ zhes pa nas/ 'og tu rang nyid gnod mdzes rgyal po sngon po=/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ mi bskyod pa rang gi thugs kar drangs/ badz+ra dhṛka thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcur 'phros/ chos 'khor bskor ba la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mdzad/ khyad par du yang sems can zhe sdang can rnams kyi zhe sdang sbyangs/

mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ sprul pa rnams gcig tu 'dus/ mi bskyod pa ye shes pa dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rang gi rigs bdag yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur/ slar byon nas rang gi mdun na 'dug pa rang gi snying gar zhugs nas 'dres pas rang rdo rje 'chang zhi ba de yongs su gyur pa las/ sngar gyi zla ba nyi gdan la thim pa'i steng du rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ 'od dmar po 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i dbus na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ reg bya rdo rje ma rang gi thugs kar drangs/ spar sha badz+ra thugs= phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can reg bya la zhen pa rnams sbyangs/ rgyal ba rnams reg bya'i bde bas mchod/ sprul pa rnams= reg bya rdo rje ma ye shes pa dang = rang gi rigs pa bdag= slar byon nas sngar gyi reg bya rdo rje ma la thim par gyur/ rnam par snang mdzad= dzi na dzika= phyogs= chos 'khor= khyad par du yang sems can gti mug can rnams kyi= rnam par snang mdzad kyi= sprul ba= rnam par snang mdzad= rang gi rigs bdag= slar byon nas rim pa dang po'i shar du 'khod/ rin chen 'byung ldan= rat+na dhṛka= chos 'khor= khyad par du yang sems can nga rgyal can rnams kyi= rin chen 'byung ldan gyi= slar byon nas rim pa dang po'i lhor 'khod/ 'od dpag med= ā ro lika= chos 'khor= khyad par du yang sems can 'dod chags can rnams= rim pa dang po'i nub tu 'khod/ don yod grub pa= prañdza dh+rika= chos 'khor= sems can brdzun du smra ba dang phrag dog can rnams kyi= don yod grub pa'i= slar byon nas rim pa dang po'i byang du 'khod/ spyan ma rang gi= mo ha ra ti= phyogs bcur 'phros= sems can nad gdon gyis gdungs pa rnams zhi bar mdzad/

sprul ba rnams= spyan ma ye shes= rang gi= slar byaun nas rim pa dang po'i shar lhor 'khod/ mā ma kī= dwe ṣa ra ti= sems can bgegs chen pos gzir ba rnams bsrung zhing rgyas par mdzad= rim pa dang po'i lho nub tu 'khod/ gos dkar mo= rā ga ra ti= sems can gdon gyis nyen pa rnams zhi zhing bsrung bar mdzad= rim pa dang po'i nub byang du 'khod/ sgrol ma rang gi= badz+ra ra ti= sems can thams cad dbang du bsdu ba'i 'phrin las mdzad/ rim pa dang po'i byang shar du 'khod/ gzugs rdo rje ma= rū pa badz+ra= phyogs= sems can gzugs la zhen pa rnams sbyangs/ rgyal ba rnams gzugs kyi bde bas mchod/ sbrul ba= gzugs rdo rje ma ye shes= rang gi=slar byon nas rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor 'khod/ sgra rdo rje ma shap+ta badz+ra= sems can sgra la= rgyal ba rnams sgra'i= rim pa gnyis pa'i lho nub tu 'khod/ dri rdo rje ma= gan+dhe badz+ra/ sems can dri la/ rgyal ba rnams dri'i= /rim pa gnyis pa'i nub byang du 'khod/ rdo rje ma= badz+ra ra sa badz+ra= sems can ro la= rgyal ba rnam ro'i= rim pa gnyis pa'i byang shar du 'khod/ byams pa rang gi= ma tri= phyogs= sems can thams cad kyi rtsa dang rgyus pa sbyangs/ sprul pa= byams pa ye shes= rang gi= slar byon nas shar sgo'i g.yas su 'khod/ sa'i snying po= k+ṣiti gar+bha= sems can thams cad mig gi skye mched= shar sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ phyag na rdo rje= badz+ra pā ṇi= sems can thams cad kyi rna ba'i skye mched= lho sgo'i g.yas su 'khod/ nam mkha'i snying po= khaṃ gar+bha= sems can thams cad kyi sna'i skye mched= lho sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ 'jig rten dbang phyug= lo ke shwa ra= sems can thams cad kyi lce'i skye mched= nub sgo'i g.yas su 'khod/ 'jam dpal= mañdzu shrī= sems can thams cad yid kyi skye mched= nub sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ sgrib ba rnam sel= sarba ni wa ra ṇa bi skaṃ pa ni= sems can thams cad ky-i lus kyi skye mched=

byang sgo'i g.yas su 'khod/ kun tu bzang po= sa man+ta bha dra= sems can thams cad kyi tshigs rnams= byang sgo'i g.yon du 'khod/ gshin rje gshed=/ya mān+ta kṛta= phyogs= dbang po la sogs pa'i gdon bcom= sprul pa= gshed rje gshed ye shes= rang gi= slar byon nas shar sgor 'khod/ shes rab mthar byed= pradzñāt+na kṛta= gshin rje dang ma mo la sogs pa'i gdon= lho sgor 'khod/ rta mgrin= pad+mān+tā kṛta= klu dang sa bdag gi gdon= nub sgor= bgegs mthar byed= bigh+nan+ta kṛta= gnod sbyin dang log 'dren la sogs pa'i gdon= byang sgor 'khod/ mi g.yo ba= a tsa la= me lha'i gdon= shar lho'i 'khod= 'dod pa'i rgyal po= ṭak+ki rā dza= bden bral gyi gdon= lho nub tu 'khod/ dbyug sngon can= nī la daṇ+ḍa= rlung lha'i gdon= nub byang du 'khod/ stobs po che= ma hā bā la= dbang ldan gyi gdon =byang shar du 'khod/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba= uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti= tshangs pa dang lha'i gdon= steng du 'khod= gnod mdzes rgyal po= sum+bha rā dza= brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug dang klu dang sa bdag gi gdon bcom/ 'og tu 'khod/ gzhal yas khang rang gi thugs kar drangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ thugs ka nas phyir phyung*/ phyogs bcur 'phros/ snod kyi nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs/ gcig tu 'dus/ ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang dang 'dres pa slar byon nas sngar gyi gzhal yas khang la thim par gyur/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog go /de nas bzlas pa ni/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i lha rnams kyi thugs ka'i rang rang gi sa bon las dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i tshogs spros te 'gro ba'i don byas nas sngags dang lhan cig tu 'jug pa'i rlung gis rang rang gi sa bon la 'jug pa'i spro ba dang bsdu ba'i dad pa can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ aḥspar badz+ra khaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ dzi na dzika oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dhṛka swā hūṃ/

oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika āḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradzñā dhṛka hrā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ mo ha ra ti laṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti maṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ badz+ra ra ti tāṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+ra dzaḥhūṃ/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+ra baṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ ra sa badz+ra ho hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmai tri mai hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṣ+ṣiṃ ti gar+bha th+l+hīṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā:badz+ra pā ṇi oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkha gar+bha oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmañdzu shrī hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ā:sarba ni wa ra ṇa bi skaṃ bi ni o+oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥs man+ta bha dra saṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta gṛta hūṃ hū/ a ā+oṃ pradzñān+ta kṛ taṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ baṃ gh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ nī la daṇ+ḍa hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥm hā bā la hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakra warti hūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ yig brgya bzla/ de nas gtso bo 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang bskul te de las bzhengs pa ni/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis yum yab la thim/ yab dam tshig sems dpa' ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ ye shes sems dpa' ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' la thim/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i zhabs kyu u ni ha la/ ha ni ha'i mgo bo la/ mgo bo ni zla tshes la/ zla tshes ni thig le la/ thig le ni nā da la/ nā da yang 'od gsal du thim par gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhis gtso bo ma mthong bas gdung ba'i yid kyis blta bar 'dod de snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bskul ba ni/ sems can khams na gnas kyi dbang phyug khyod ni rdo rje'i thugs/ dga' ba yid 'ong don chen 'dod pas bdag la bskyab tu gsol/ mgon po gal te de ring bdag ni gson par mchis bzhed na/

sems can yab chen gnyen mchog bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje'i sku khyod bka' yi 'khor lo sems can kun la phan/ sangs rgyas don du byang chub don dam rjes su phan ston pa/ mgon po gal te de ring = 'dod chags dam tshig chags pas bdag la dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ khyod ni rdo rje'i gsung ste kun la phan zhing thugs brtse ba/ 'jig rten dag gi dgos pa'i don mdzad pa la rtag tu brtson/ mgon po gal te de ring = rab dga'i spyod pa kun tu bzang pos bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ khyod ni rdo rje 'dod pa dam tshig mchog gi phan don che/ yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi gdung mchog mnyam pa nyid gzigs pa/ mgon po gal te de ring = yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter gyur bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ ces bskul bas sngon gyi smon lam dang thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'od gsal las sems dpa' gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi skur bzhengs te/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ de nas bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkhas pa che/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /gsang ba'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal mchog gi mchog /ston pa rdo rje phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'dra dri ma med/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /rdo rje gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dag pa ngo bo nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyi nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/

de bzhin du sbyar te/ bā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pai/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ye/ shat+pa/ rū pa/ shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spa ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shri ye āḥhūṃ/ bdag nyid kyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong k+ṣuṃ las sa gzhi/ ming med suṃ las ri rab tu gyur pas sa la gnas pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus nas bdud rtsi'i snying po blangs te/ mgron rnams kyi ljags hūṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dmar po 'od kyi sbu gu can rnams su gyur/ mchod do/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag / drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi zhal du= rgyal sras blo gros rin chen gyi= dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi= rgyal sras ma taṅki pa'i= grub chen tai lo pa'i/ paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i/ sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā'i/ mtshur ston dbang gi rdo rje'i/ /'khon ston gad pa kirti'i/ bya sgang ba bsod nams rin chen gyi/ thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs kyi/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs kyi/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od kyi/ chos rje bu ston rin chen grub kyi/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams kyi/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i/ slar yang rgyal pa rdo rje 'chang gi /rgyal sras phyag na rdo rje'i/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti'i/ klu las skyais pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i/ mnga' bdag bi su kalpa'i/ dpal ldan sā ra ta pa'i/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ dpal ldan zla ba grags pa'i/ slob pa'i rdo rje'i/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i/ bla ma sprin gyi shugs can gyi/

rje rin po che mgos kyi/ mang ra ba seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi/ rngog ye shes seng ge'i/ rngog ār+ya de ba'i/ glan tsha nyi ma lcam gyi/ ltag pa rin chen grags kyi/ thur lha ba tshul khrims skyabs kyi/ thang spe ba 'phags pa skyabs kyi/ gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od kyi/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyi/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'od kyi/ chos rje bu ston rin chen grub kyi/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi/ sgra sgyur nam mkha' bzang po'i/ mnyam med rje btsun red mda' ba chen po'i/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun shes rab seṅge'i/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang sbyin pa'i/ rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgya mtsho'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang ba'i bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra dh+rika oṃ āḥhūṃ/ spar+sha badz+ra oṃ āḥhūṃ/ dzi na dzi ka oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ sum+bha rā dza oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ gzhan yang rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sngon sangs rgyas mthong ba/ dam pa'i chos thos pa/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la brten pa/ bstan pa dang 'khor rnam bzhi skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bsten cing bsgrubs pa'i bsrung ma dam tshig can rnams ky-i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ yul sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ zhing skyong dang*/ klu la sogs pa rnams gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa dang sems can thams cad lhar gyur pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ mgron thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshim par gyur/

gsang mchod ni/ rang gi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga par dbus ma'i nor bu la oṃ yig gis mtshan zhing bu ga yi ge phaṭa ser bos bkag pa/ yum gyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las āḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ bu ge yi ge phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ rdo rje dang pad+ma'i nang 'od zer rnam pa lngas gang bar gyur/ rang nyid rin 'byung du gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang nyid mi bskyod par gyur/ hūṃ snyoms par 'jug pa'i las la gnas par byas pas mchog tu dga' pa'i bde ba thob/ rang nyid don grub tu gyur/ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ dkyil 'khor ba'i lha thams cad kyis kyang lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ste bde ba chen po dang de kho na nyid dbyer mi phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pas gsang ba dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas dgyes par gyur/ bsgom pa'i rten brten pa rnams slar lus pa bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis rnam snang nas gnod mdzes kyi bar gyi spyan drangs te rang gi spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su 'khod pa ni/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ lte bar rin chen 'byung ldan/ brla'i rtsa bar don yod grub pa/ lte bar spyan ma/ snying gar mā ma kī/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ spyi gtsug tu sgrol ma/ mig tu sa'i snying po/ rna bar phyag na rdo rje/ snar nam mkha'i snying po/ lcer 'jig rten dbang phyug /snying gar 'jam dpal/ gsang gnas su sgrib pa rnam sel/ tshigs rnams la kun tu bzang po/ spyi gtsug tu byams pa/ mig gi sgor gzugs rdo rje ma/ rna ba'i sgor sgra rdo rje ma/ sna'i sgor dri rdo rje ma/ kha'i sgor ro rdo rje ma/

lag pa g.yas la gshin rje gshed/ lag pa g.yon la gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ kha la rta mgrin/ rdo rje la bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ dpung pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar mi g.yo ba/ dpung pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ pus mo g.yas la dbyug sngon can/ pus mo g.yon la stobs po che/ spyi gtsug tu gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnyis su gnod mdzes rgyal po/ gzhal yas khang gi cha so so yang rang gi lus kyi cha so so la thim par gyur/ mtha'i mdzad pa ni/ rang yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la dbang bskur/ sgrib pa sbyangs/ hūṃ yig tu gyur/ de nam mkha'i khams gang ba yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'chang du gyur pa rnams rang gi 'od zer gyis drangs nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ o yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho ྅haṃ/ bzlas pa nas 'di'i bar las rgyal mchog go /thun mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus khrau bo bcu dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu ba'i lte ba'i nang du 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa spyan drangs shing bsrung 'khor gyi phyi rol tu phyogs skyong bco lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ klu rnams dang sems can thams cad bkug pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su mi bskyod pa yab yum/ shar du rnam snang/ ces pa nas/ 'og tu gnod mdzes rgyal po/ phyi'i shar du rdo rje mtshon cha ser po/ ces pa nas/ 'dus pa'i lha shes rab ma dang*/ zhes pa nas/ sbu gu can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhrīḥzhes sogs kyi chu bzhi bul/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu bsil nas/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rīka hūṃ/ spar sha badz+ra khaṃ/ dzi na dzika oṃ/ ces pa nas/ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ/ sarba duṣ+tān sa ma ya mu dra pra bhaṃ dza ka ma ma shin+taṃ rak+ṣa tsa ku ru swāhā/

zhes pas lha so gnyis la 'bul/ de nas ro dril sngar ltar la/ oṃ āḥdus gsum skyes pa/ ces pa nas/ bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes phyogs skyong la 'bul/ oṃ āḥhriḥpra wa ra sad ka ri añdza mā ṇaṃ pra tīts+tsa hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥnas ar+ghaṃ pra tā+-its+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra taṃ pu la swāhā/ oṃ sarba twa thā ga ta puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dh+rika o āḥhūṃ/ ces pa nas/ sum+bha dza rā dzā oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wa ra puṣ+pe/ ces pa nas/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha hūṃ swā hā/ oṃ da sha di ka= oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ma rnyed yongs su zhes pa nas/ bzod mdzod rigs/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ zhes pa nas/ swa twa ā hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yig brgya brjod/ oṃ yo ga shudhāḥsarba dharma yo ga shudho ྅haṃ/ pad skor 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bdag nyid la thim zhing*/ se gol gdab cing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong 'khor bcas rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ de nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs kyi smon lam rgyas bsdus ci rigs gdab bo/ /yang rgyud nas bshad pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang po sbyor ba tsam bya bar 'dod na/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa nas/ pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko ྅haṃ/ gi bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar la/ de nas thig le dbyung ba sogs dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi skor bzhag /lus dkyil la dmigs te/ bzlas bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba'i/ zhes pa nas/ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar lha thams cad kyi bzlas pa byas nas/ yig brgya'i 'jug tu/ mi bskyod rdo rje nas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mnyes par gyur/ gzhal yas khang gi cha so so yang nas thim par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i nas shudho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar sngar ltar ro/ /lhag mos lus la bsdu ba'i tshe lha'i gdan rnams kyang mi dmigs par bsam zhing*/

bsngo smon dang gtor ma 'bul tshul ni/ sngar ltar ro/ /rgyun pa'i zhal 'don yin na rgyas bsdus gnyis ka la'ang tshogs zhing gi mjug tu/ dngos po med pa bsgom pa med zhes pa nas 'jug tu rung zhing*/ de dag gi skabs su lus dkyil gyi lha'i skyed chog dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi spro bsdu la rgyas bsdus ji ltar bya ba ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyi rang skal gyi ched dang gzhan 'ga' zhig la'ang phan srid par bsams te cung zad re kha bskang bas co ne dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa'i par shing rnams ni tshe ring bkra shis kyis dad pas bsgrubs shing yi ge pa ni sngags raṃ pa byams pa rin chen no/ /maṅgalaṃ//
